quote: DRIVING A SCUDERIA FERRARI HP CAR FOR THE FIRST TIME WAS ONE OF THE BEST FEELINGS OF MY LIFE.
bio: ‘Still I Rise’ – these are the words emblazoned across the back of Lewis Hamilton’s helmet and tattooed across his shoulders. In a stellar Formula 1 career spanning spells with McLaren, Mercedes and Ferrari, Hamilton has risen to the top of the all-time pole positions list and matched the legendary Michael Schumacher’s seven world titles. Is he the G.O.A.T? Few would deny that he’s in the conversation – twinning his relentless speed with a refusal to conform to stereotypes. Yes, he may now be in the most challenging phase of his journey – a tough first season with Ferrari was his first not to feature a Grand Prix podium appearance – but few doubt Hamilton still has more to add to the F1 history books.
